posts.subject: Cs:go Knife server
posts.bodyHtml:
So there was a player "TQ/gaming" That I protected yestraday because he was getting abused but there was a plot twist today as he started to call us "retards" "Ding dong retards" or "fuckers" It's not the first time that Doo Doo has warned him, like yestraday he got muted after mic abusing and he continued today.
His behavior was not in the line of the dream community rules and I think when he comes back again he will probably abuse again due to not being any admin on the server.

Thanks for the insight. I will ask a couple of the people in the list about this. But be sure to get a demo or recording of what is going on at the time. Especially at the fact that you feel confident enough to predict what his actions will be.

I don't have anything to record with but I will surealy take it to consideration.
Thank you fiddles.

CS:GO offers a demo recorder to record your p.o.v. in a match.


Nachtfrische wrote a tutorial on how to record things -> Wie erstelle ich eine Demo? / How do I record a demo?

Ty.


But the point is that Doo doo has warned his behaviour yestraday after him talking about "naked old people in his car" and exessive swering/ mic abusing.
Yeah, it is crucial for you to learn how to record demos as it is concrete evidence against the accused player.

Next time do "record DEMONAME" in console and STOP to stop recording.
You can find the Files under:
..\Steam\SteamApps\common\Counter-Strike Global Offensive\cstrike\..
